The object resembles a vintage or industrial-style lighter with a ribbed metal casing. A small, soft-focus orange flame is visible emerging from the top right edge of the device. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the metallic texture and the ridges on the side of the casing.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The horizontal ribs on the side of the lighter show slight inconsistency in depth and alignment; some lines fade or merge slightly into the adjacent ridges, suggesting minor generative smoothing rather than precise mechanical molding.

The geometry where the flame emerges lacks a clear, rigid nozzle structure. The metal edge appears to soften and blend into the base of the flame, lacking the sharp physical separation expected between a metal fuel jet and a gas flame.

Significant depth-of-field blur is present on the fingers and background. While this mimics photography, the transition zone between the sharp lighter and blurred finger shows slight haloing/bleeding typical of AI generation.
